title: Grilled Deodeok with French Herb Skewers
description: A delightful summer dish featuring the sweet flavor of deodeok paired with the freshness of French herbs, grilled to perfection on skewers.

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: Wooden or metal, soaked in water for 30 minutes

instructions: Soak skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together French thyme, French rosemary, and garlic.
Thread 1-2 deodeok pieces onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the tops of the deodeok with olive oil and sprinkle with the herb mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill skewers for 3-4 minutes per side, or until deodeok is tender and slightly charred.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional fresh herbs if desired.
